# Paired-device remote

<!-- Generated by php artisan standards:install from tey/standards; do not edit. -->

A second device (a phone remote, a paired screen) acts for a signed-in user through a short-lived pairing, re-authorised on every request. Build your own on access-tenancy.device-pairing; there is no generator yet.

No generator yet; follow the summary and stamp the file `standards-pattern: ui-page.remote`.

Kit: none.
Checks: none. Run `php artisan standards:check --changed` before committing.

Conventions:
- Pairing and its security follow access-tenancy.device-pairing.
- Command endpoints are CSRF-protected (or token-bound), and the feed is private, no-store.
- Commands are ephemeral, read since a cursor; nothing is recorded.

Related: `access-tenancy.device-pairing`, `ui-page.signed-guest`.

Graduates: Graduate to standards:make pairing when a second app needs it.
